snippet.title: Go, Diego, Go!™: Diego's Underwater Adventure (Flash) - Full Game HD Walkthrough - No Commentary
snippet.description:
If you enjoyed watching this video, please leave a like and subscribe! I would very much appreciate it!

Why am I playing a Diego game? Well some of these are very nostalgic to me and of course many others. Only a tough guy like me (HAHA) plays games like these in his twenties. Enjoy!

Dora the Explorer & Go, Diego, Go! Games (PC, GBA, DS, NGC, PS1, PS2, Flash) playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYwqV0N4djf8lZ-Qn15OnSWo6WQeM7C-n
Dora the Explorer: Journey to the Purple Planet (NGC) playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYwqV0N4djf_1B5ize9TU_brZaFxLMLZc

Story: The baby sea turtles need Luna's light to get home to the ocean. Help Diego find Luna's different pieces so she can return to the sky and light the turtles' way.

Release Date - September 10, 2008
Genre - Point-And-Click, Adventure
Platforms - Flash / Browser (PC)
Publisher - NickJr.
Developer - NickJr.

My Xbox gamertag: TGG Yari
My PlayStation gamertag: ToughGamingGuyYT
My Steam: ToughGamingGuy

Wanna see more of my fantastic walkthroughs? Give it a go: https://www.youtube.com/user/ToughGamingGuy
